reviews.review_title: I had a very disappointing experience…
reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience with Temu’s customer service.

I received a package addressed to my name and my address, but the contents were completely different from the items I ordered. None of the products matched my order.

I contacted customer support multiple times, provided clear photos of all the incorrect items, the shipping label, and all the requested evidence. I also made it clear that I was happy to return every single item because they were not the products I purchased.

Despite all the evidence, my refund request was rejected four times. Every response I received was a generic template saying that, after reviewing my case, they could not approve my request. They never explained why the items I received were considered correct, nor did they address the evidence I submitted.

I wasn’t trying to keep the wrong items for free—I simply wanted either the products I actually paid for or a refund. Instead, I was left with products I never ordered and no meaningful support from Temu.

This has been one of the most frustrating customer service experiences I have ever had. I cannot recommend buying from Temu if something goes wrong with your order, as resolving the issue appears to be extremely difficult.
